recipes.name: Honey Toast inspired by Chainsaw Man
ingredients: 270 g whole milk, at room temperature
instructions: For Simple Honey Toast:
For the Toast
Using a toaster: Place the slice of milk bread in the toaster and toast until golden brown. - 1 slice of milk bread
Using an oven: Preheat the oven to 375° F. Place the slice of milk bread on a sheet tray lined with parchment paper. Bake for about 5 minutes, or until the bread is toasted to your liking.
For the Assembly
Dollop strawberry jam, orange marmalade, and plum jam on the toasted bread. - 2 tbsp strawberry jam - 2 tbsp orange marmalade - 2 tbsp plum jam
Generously pour honey over the jams. - 2 generous tbsp honey
Add a small square of unsalted butter on top of the honey. - 1 small square of unsalted butter
Finish with an unrelenting dust of cinnamon. - 1 tsp cinnamon
Serve.
For Café Honey Brick Toast:
For the Tangzhong
In a medium sauce pan, combine bread flour with whole milk. - 50 g bread flour - 90 g whole milk
Stir over medium heat until the mixture becomes sticky and tight.
Once thickened, transfer to a bowl, cover, and refrigerate until cool.
For the Milk Bread Dough
In the bowl of a stand mixer, combine bread flour, instant yeast, sugar, and kosher salt. - 480 g bread flour - 5 g instant yeast - 30 g sugar - 5 g kosher salt
Break the cooled tangzhong into little pieces and add to the dry mixture. - For the Tangzhong
Add heavy cream, honey, and whole milk to the mixture. - 60 g heavy cream - 40 g honey - 270 g whole milk at room temperature
Mix with the dough hook at low to medium speed for about 4-6 minutes until combined.
Add soft unsalted butter and continue kneading for an additional 6-8 minutes until smooth. - 30 g unsalted butter cubed
Transfer the dough to a lightly greased mixing bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and let it proof for 1-2 hours or until doubles in size.
For the Shaping and Baking
Preheat your oven to 375° F.
Grease rectangular loaf pan with softened butter. (If the pan has holes in the bottom, place a pan lined with parchment paper underneath anything you bake in the loaf pan.) - softened unsalted butter
Once the dough has proofed, gently deflate it and divide it into 4 equal parts. Roll each part into a ball. - For the Milk Bread Dough
Place the dough balls side by side in the prepared pan.
Cover and let rise for 45 minutes
Bake with the pan lid on for 30-45 minutes, until golden brown and cooked through. The internal temperature should be 200-205° F.
Allow the bread to cool to room temperature.
Using a paring knife, slice off the top of the loaf and hollow out the center, leaving a 1-inch border around the sides.
Cut the removed bread into small cubes.
For the Butter Jam Mixture
Melt butter in a mixing bowl. - 1 stick of butter
Stir in orange marmalade, salt, and cinnamon. - 4 tbsp orange marmalade - pinch of salt - 2 dashes of cinnamon
Mix until well combined.
For the Assembly
Spread the butter jam mixture inside and outside the surfaces of the hollowed bread cube. - For the Butter Jam Mixture
Toss the small bread cubes in any remaining mixture.

Bake the small bread cubes and the hollowed bread cube on a parchment-lined sheet tray at 375° F for 8-10 minutes until golden brown. (Face the hollowed bread open toward the back of the oven for best results.)
Slice fresh plums and stawberries. - 2 fresh plums thinly sliced - 5 fresh strawberries thinly sliced

Fill the hollowed bread cube with the small toasted bread cubes, alternating layers of strawberry jam, fresh strawberries, plum jam, more bread cubes, and orange marmalade. - 4 tbsp plum jam - 2 tbsp honey - 1 tsp cinnamon - 4 tbsp strawberry jam - 4 tbsp orange marmalade - 2 fresh plums thinly sliced - 5 fresh strawberries thinly sliced

Top with a scoop of ice cream, drizzle with condensed milk (if desired), honey, and garnish with a sprig of mint. - 1 scoop of vanilla ice cream - condensed milk (optional for drizzling) - fresh mint (for garnish)
